criteria.criterion: A project created through the scaffold dispatcher contains the factory policy file in its initial git commit
criteria.plannedImplementation: Invoke the existing plugin/scripts/register-with-factory.ps1 from new-project.ps1 after scaffolding and stamping, but before setup.ps1 initializes and commits the project.
criteria.plannedVerification: new-project/tests/e2e-registration-commit-test.ps1 runs the dispatcher with a reachable temporary gh fixture, reads the first commit from the created repository, and asserts that .github/agent-factory.yml can be read from that commit.
materialConcerns: release impact: registration timing determines whether files enter the initial commit

criteria.criterion: When factory registration cannot reach its source during scaffold, the project is still created successfully and reports that registration was skipped
criteria.plannedImplementation: Call the registration script without making its source failure fatal, relying on its supported zero-exit skip behavior before setup.ps1 continues.
criteria.plannedVerification: new-project/tests/e2e-registration-unreachable-test.ps1 forces gh to return failure, asserts the dispatcher exits successfully, asserts the destination exists, and asserts the captured scaffold output contains the unique Factory registration skipped message.
materialConcerns: release impact: unauthenticated or unavailable factory access must not block scaffolding

criteria.criterion: The existing end-to-end scaffold verification still passes after the registration step is integrated — no regression in basic scaffold functionality
criteria.plannedImplementation: Preserve the existing dispatcher scaffold, stamp, and verification flow while inserting the registration attempt at the required pre-setup point.
criteria.plannedVerification: The existing new-project/tests/e2e-dotnet-cli.ps1 check is exercised directly; it continues asserting successful dispatcher completion, project creation, and the cli harness stamp, and additionally asserts the unique registration-attempt message appeared in the same output.
materialConcerns: public-contract compatibility: existing scaffold verification and output must remain successful while adding registration
